topics.name: Matrices (up to order 3)
topics.detail: Types, equality, addition, subtraction, multiplication, transpose, symmetric/skew‑symmetric, singular/non‑singular, adjoint, inverse, eigenvalues, Cayley‑Hamilton theorem (statement & application), diagonalisation.

topics.name: Determinants (up to order 3)
topics.detail: Expansion, minors, cofactors, properties, Cramer’s rule (3 unknowns), rank of matrix, homogeneous & non‑homogeneous systems (statements & applications).

topics.name: Complex Numbers
topics.detail: Cartesian, polar & exponential forms, modulus, amplitude, conjugate, algebra, cube roots of unity, De Moivre’s theorem (statement & simple problems).

topics.name: Co‑ordinate Geometry (2D)
topics.detail: Polar coordinates, relation to Cartesian, conic sections – definition, properties, tangents & normals.

topics.name: Vector Algebra
topics.detail: Position vector, ratio formula, resolution, dot & cross products (properties & applications: work, projection, area, moment), scalar & vector triple products, linear combination, dependence/independence.

topics.name: Differential Calculus
topics.detail: Function, domain/range, limit, continuity, standard limits, types of discontinuity, derivatives (1st & 2nd order), Rolle’s theorem, MVT, indeterminate forms, L’Hôpital’s rule.

topics.name: Application of Derivative
topics.detail: Geometric meaning, rate measurement, maxima/minima (one variable).

topics.name: Partial Differentiation
topics.detail: Definition, evaluation, homogeneous functions, Euler’s theorem (2 variables, without proof).

topics.name: Integral Calculus
topics.detail: Integration as inverse of differentiation, standard integrals, substitution, by parts, partial fractions, definite integral & properties, area under a curve.

topics.name: Ordinary Differential Equations
topics.detail: Order, degree. First order first degree: separation of variables, homogeneous, exact, linear. First order but not first degree. Linear second order with constant coefficients – CF, PI for polynomial, eᵃˣ, sin ax, cos ax, eᵃˣV.

topics.name: Probability
topics.detail: Random experiment, sample space, events, classical definition, total probability, compound probability, Bayes’ theorem (statements & simple problems).

topics.name: Units & dimensions
topics.detail: CGS, MKS, SI, dimensional analysis, errors, significant figures.

topics.name: Kinematics
topics.detail: Speed, velocity, acceleration, rectilinear/circular motion, vectors.

topics.name: Laws of motion
topics.detail: Newton’s laws, force, momentum, inertia, moment of inertia, impulse, couples, equilibrium, conservation of momentum, centripetal/centrifugal forces, angular motion, torque, friction, banking of roads.

topics.name: Work, power, energy
topics.detail: Definitions, conservation, kinetic & potential energy.

topics.name: Gravitation
topics.detail: Universal law, variation of g, gravitational potential energy, projectile, vertical circular motion.

topics.name: Elasticity
topics.detail: Stress‑strain, Hooke’s law, Young’s modulus, bulk modulus, rigidity modulus, Poisson’s ratio, elastic energy.

topics.name: Surface tension
topics.detail: Cohesive/adhesive forces, surface energy, angle of contact, droplets, bubbles, capillarity, effect of impurity/temperature.

topics.name: Fluid mechanics
topics.detail: Pascal’s law, hydraulic lift, buoyancy, Archimedes’ principle, streamline/turbulent flow, continuity equation, Bernoulli’s theorem, viscosity, Stokes’ law, terminal velocity.

topics.name: Thermal expansion
topics.detail: Linear, areal, volume expansion, coefficient relations, density change with temperature.

topics.name: Heat transfer
topics.detail: Conduction, convection, radiation, thermal conductivity.

topics.name: Thermodynamics
topics.detail: Thermal equilibrium, calorimetry, zeroth law, heat, work, internal energy, first law, specific heats of gas, isothermal/isobaric/isochoric/adiabatic processes.

topics.name: Reflection of light
topics.detail: Plane mirror, image formation.

topics.name: Refraction of light
topics.detail: Laws, refractive index, total internal reflection, critical angle, optical fibre.

topics.name: Lens
topics.detail: Convex & concave lenses, image formation, lens formula, power of lens, equivalent focal length & power of two thin lenses in contact.

topics.name: Photoelectricity
topics.detail: Photoemission, work function, photoelectric current vs intensity/frequency, stopping potential, threshold frequency, photon, Einstein’s equation, solar photovoltaic cell.

topics.name: Atomic Structure
topics.detail: Bohr model, de Broglie wave, quantum numbers, Aufbau, Pauli’s exclusion, Hund’s rule, electronic configuration, isotopes, isotones, isobars, hybridisation (sp³, sp², sp) & molecular shapes.

topics.name: Chemical Bonding
topics.detail: Electrovalent, covalent, coordinate bonds, hydrogen bonding, crystalline & amorphous solids, covalent bonds in C, Si, Ge.

topics.name: Acids, Bases & Salts
topics.detail: Mole concept, Arrhenius & Lewis concepts, neutralisation, hydrolysis, equivalent weight, concentration units (normality, molarity, molality, formality), pH scale, indicators, buffer solution, solubility product, common ion effect.

topics.name: Oxidation, Reduction, Electrochemistry
topics.detail: Redox balancing (ion‑electron method), redox titration, electrolysis, Faraday’s laws, electrolysis of CuSO₄, electroplating, electrorefining, electrochemical cells (dry cell, lead storage cell), electrochemical series.

topics.name: Chemical Equilibrium
topics.detail: Reversible/irreversible reactions, Le Chatelier’s principle, industrial processes: Haber’s process, Ostwald’s process, Contact process, catalysis.

topics.name: Metallurgy
topics.detail: Minerals, ores, gangue, flux, slag, extraction of Fe, Cu, Al. Alloys – composition & uses (brass, bronze, stainless steel, etc.), amalgams, cast iron, wrought iron, steel.

topics.name: Water
topics.detail: Hardness (types, causes, units, disadvantages), EDTA estimation, removal by Permutit, ion‑exchange, phosphate conditioning, Calgon treatment.

topics.name: Organic Chemistry
topics.detail: Classification, homologous series, functional groups, isomerism, IUPAC nomenclature. Preparation & properties of methane, ethylene, acetylene, methylated spirit, rectified spirit, power alcohol, proof spirit. Uses of benzene, naphthalene, phenol.

topics.name: Components & instruments
topics.detail: Resistors, capacitors, inductors, PMMC & MI instruments, Wheatstone bridge.

topics.name: Transformers
topics.detail: Principle, construction, BH characteristic, transformation ratio, equivalent circuit, losses, regulation, efficiency, auto‑transformer.

topics.name: Electrical machines
topics.detail: Types of motors, rotating magnetic field, DC motor & single‑phase induction motor (construction, working, torque‑speed characteristics, speed control).

topics.name: DC circuits
topics.detail: Voltage/current sources, source transformation, Thevenin’s & Norton’s theorems, Kirchhoff’s laws, superposition, time‑domain behaviour of reactive components.

topics.name: AC circuits
topics.detail: Amplitude, frequency, phase, peak/average/RMS values, phasor representation, impedance, power factor, active/reactive power, star‑delta connection, simple RLC circuits.

topics.name: Semiconductor devices
topics.detail: Energy bands, intrinsic/extrinsic, P‑type, N‑type, PN junction diode, PNP & NPN transistors, MOSFET, CMOS.

topics.name: Analog circuits
topics.detail: Op‑amp, virtual ground, inverting/non‑inverting amplifiers, adder, subtractor, integrator, differentiator.

topics.name: Digital electronics
topics.detail: Boolean algebra, basic gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR, EX‑OR, EX‑NOR) – truth tables, symbols, combinations.
